nodes.label: Smartwatch Integration Illustration
nodes.description: White outline icon of a smartwatch displaying a heart rate / pulse waveform on its screen. Promotes wearable fitness tracking integration — the smartwatch with biometric monitoring symbolises the app's ability to connect with or complement wearable devices for real-time health data (heart rate, activity tracking).
nodes.feature: Smartwatch / wearable device integration for biometric fitness tracking
